scope: The freestanding 1983 Stanford Clock Tower at Lasuen and Escondido Malls, represented in February 2009. Includes its glazed base, four-sided bell chamber, clock faces, stone steps and the two immediately attached pergola arms. The nearby campus buildings and internal clockwork mechanisms are outside scope.

originalReview.notes: The 2009 front-oblique view establishes the tan rectangular tower, square belfry voids, bronzed clock skeletons, recessed tall panels, tall base glazing, three shallow terrace steps and two attached colonnaded connections.
